description: Enkept is a people operations platform that keeps the whole employee lifecycle in one place — hiring, attendance, leave, payroll inputs, assets, documents, learning and recognition. It is built for operations teams who want a single, consistent portal instead of a stack of disconnected tools.

notes: Expense management end to end — advances, claims, draft reports, trips with itineraries, batch export and reimbursement through payroll.
Asset register overhauled — record details, movement register, assignment and termination workflow, maintenance schedules and category dashboard.
Attendance engine fixes for open shift, grace period, weekly-off on no-punch days and more reliable connector sync.
Device connectors and custom user mapping — clearer logs, payload view, direction mapping and date/time field formats for imports.
Kiosk bulk file import respects explicit IN/OUT in the file or auto first-in / rest-out when the column is blank.
Benefits for staff — richer category navigation, history and portal listing aligned with admin setup.
Payroll statutory setup and investment declaration flows refined for new merchants and staff POI.
Rich text across settings moves from TinyMCE to Tiptap (self-hosted, lazy-loaded).
Admin home refresh — celebrate birthdays and milestones, appreciation given/received tabs and clearer admin tab names.
Proof of investments — bulk copy and approve by section, highlighted fields and approver workflows on staff records.
Tax liabilities and TDS challans — associated vs unassociated challans with split-up view for finance.
Payroll reports and salary hold/withhold behaviour aligned with paid status and downloadable XLS where supported.
Forum — category filters on My topics and bookmarks, comment controls and long-name layout on staff views.
Performance — copy review setup and submissions; template copy in configuration; separated employees excluded from new launches where intended.
Recruitment — public screening answers visible in admin, interviewer assignment on interview rounds, onboarding tasks dates validated.
Staff ID cards show your organization logo; merchant country code defaults from org profile.
Staff events on every person record — one timeline for joining, probation, transfers, deputation, training, separation and more.
ek-next Home2 layout rolled across admin and staff — FTE, Document Hub, Resource Booking, Integrations and core landing tabs.
Navigation regrouped under Time & Presence (attendance, leave, geo track, timesheets) and Engage (documents, benefits).
Alumni portal and directory — search, separation date, organization page and home experience for alumni users.
Resource booking and notices aligned with the new home; staff booking actions simplified where design required.
Leave adjustments and approval messaging polish; work-hub onboarding and separation links in Me and My Team.
Organization setups use consistent ek-next headers, back navigation and permission-aware setup cards.
Maps in settings use Leaflet / OpenStreetMap instead of legacy map provider.
Switch between Admin and Staff from the sidebar — one linked session, logout clears both without signing in again.
Asset management on ek-next — subscriptions, renewals tab, provision and booking notes, reports and view/manage screens.
Prior payroll upload for migrations and historical months with corrected month labelling on staff payroll views.
Document Hub — org docs and issued documents with permission fixes for staff and admin.
Organization refresh — Business Partners (formerly vendors), sites and locations, and business partner flows in People.
Global search — permission-aware quick actions, stable column layout on multi-tab modules and first-load filter fixes.
Performance reviews — eligibility without redundant user filters; salary/revision UI aligned with payroll expectations.
Recognition and awards — staff appreciation entry points and award program view/manage stability on the new theme.
Payroll groups — monthly salary with per-group attendance windows, month-aligned staff assignment and pay-run initiation rules.
Staff loans — schedules, manual repayment, pause instalments, payroll vs manual paid status and interest modes.
Staff giving and pledges — admin and self-service flows with payroll integration fixes across the release.
Embedded Metabase analytics — custom dashboards with Apply on filters, session stability and payroll-ready PDF export.
Asset subscriptions — auto-renewal status on start date, renewal records from new subscriptions and subscription dashboard.
Module subscriptions for super-admin — trial defaults, grants, pricing and asset subscription entitlements per merchant.
Performance salary revision captures current salary validation and ties revision design to staff payroll.
Notifications hardening — email/SMS templates and history, per-merchant disable for SMTP/integrations, timezone on email history.

Benefit offerings — availing is limited to the benefit start date and offering window, time-slot validation, geolocation areas need at least 3 coordinates, face-match camera fix and edits update the offering instead of duplicating it.
Payroll groups — change or reassign groups, default group on new employees, new table structure and clearer error messages.
Pay runs — "All" option for past, current and yearly payroll generation, pay-run generation and bulk delete fixes, month filter and month-year display on Pay run and Pay history.
Performance goals — cascaded goal, goal title and cycle filter fixes, with Job Role Competencies reachable under Configuration.
Alumni portal — global search on sub tabs, automatic logout on rejoining and boomerang rehires counted in admin alumni views.
Staff portal — pages and tabs are searchable and Apply Leave sits in the header.
Staff events and loans — rejoin entries, event time zone and loan repayment decimal validation fixed.
Security and audit — Content-Security-Policy headers, XSS hardening, and activity log for logins, logouts, asset and subscription assignment.
